[d1] Excess iodine intake can disrupt thyroid homeostasis and cause thyroid dysfunction including hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism, and autoimmune thyroiditis [d1], and individuals with preexisting thyroid disease or a history of iodine deficiency are particularly susceptible to these effects [d3].
